_comment: Providers whose formal reviews MUST go through bin/ai-review-engine. pool/preflight refuse a review that bypasses the runner for any provider listed here. Door scripts own provider bits only (binary/profile, credentials, model pin, tool set, parse to our report shape). See docs/reviewer-harness-consolidation.md and plan_reviewer-pipeline-core.md §9 Phase D.

grok.notes: First proven door. Session CLI bin/ai-grok-review remains for persistent named sessions; formal pool reviews dispatch through the engine.
